annotations.text: COLORE betweenness — the first corpus ontology imported from a real external Common Logic repository (Grüninger's COLORE). A ternary between(x,y,z) with symmetry between(x,y,z)→between(z,y,x), identity-of-ends, and transitivity. Proof that the CLIF→EGI pipeline reads genuinely foreign first-order ontologies, not only Arisbe-authored ones.

Imported from corpus/ontologies/colore_between.clif (verbatim COLORE content, CC BY-SA 4.0). 0 facts; 4 Horn rules → +0 derived; 1 rule left to the contest game. This is a **relational FOL** theory — its axioms use equality and negation in bodies/heads, so materialization leaves them to the contest/deduction game (no A-box to forward-chain); the honest reasoning value is in the contest, not the Horn closure. This module's cl-imports chain was resolved by hand; the colore_field UoD beside it now resolves its chain **automatically** (cl_import_resolver), and COLORE function-term modules import too — function terms relationalise on import ((density (dmv v m)) ↦ ∃z (dmv(v,m,z) ∧ density(z))).
